# NonLinLoc interoperability fixture

These are small synthetic files generated by the official NonLinLoc programs,
not by GraphSplit's grid writer. They test the binary layout, velocity units,
source coordinates, geographic projection and TIME interpolation independently.
No field observations are included.

Source: [NonLinLoc](https://github.com/ut-beg-texnet/NonLinLoc), commit
`7a62fa46eff682083352a2ca28e63a4f415d941b`, programs reporting version 7.1.05,
compiled and run on macOS arm64 on 9 October 2026. The source was unchanged.
The build used the dependencies in its CMake configuration, including
`NO_IEEE_PROTOCOL` for `Time_3d_NLL_multiSource.c`.

`check.in` specifies a 25 × 23 × 17 grid with 250 m spacing, a smooth layered
P/S velocity model, a SIMPLE geographic origin at 64°N, 20°W, and rotation 27°.
The station is at 64.005°N, 20.01°W, with elevation 150 m. `check_s.in` changes
only the phase requested by Grid2Time.

After building NonLinLoc using its instructions, run in this directory:

```bash
Vel2Grid check.in
Grid2Time check.in
Grid2Time check_s.in
```

The `model/` files are native SLOW_LEN FLOAT output. The `time/` files contain
P and S travel times from that same model and station. All buffers are little
endian. Each buffer is only 39,100 bytes.

`sample_times.c` is a small test driver calling NonLinLoc's `get_transform`,
`latlon2rect`, `OpenGrid3dFile` and `ReadAbsInterpGrid3d`. Link it against the
NonLinLoc grid-library objects (the `GRID_LIB_OBJS` target in its CMake build):

```bash
# Include directories and object paths depend on the NonLinLoc build directory.
cc -I/path/to/NonLinLoc/src/include -I/path/to/NonLinLoc/src \
   sample_times.c /path/to/grid-library-objects/*.o -lm -o sample_times
./sample_times time/check.P.STA.time > expected.csv
./sample_times time/check.S.STA.time > expected_s.csv
```

The object glob above denotes all grid-library objects, including the nested
matrix, JSON, vector, random-number and octree objects; use their actual build
paths. The driver explicitly selects the same SIMPLE transform as the control
files before querying the grids.

GraphSplit's regression test deliberately uses a different internal origin
(64.02°N, 19.985°W). It must reproduce the independent NLL projected coordinates
to 0.1 micrometre and imported interpolation values to 0.1 microsecond. The
latter tolerance allows NLL's Float32 interpolation return value. It also
checks finite-difference spatial derivatives and rejects a displaced station.
The internally built FMM times need not equal NLL's Podvin–Lecomte times: their
numerical discretizations differ. Agreement within one native-cell transit time (50 ms for P, 86 ms for S)
detects gross model-unit or coordinate errors without claiming solver equivalence.
Velocity samples are also checked against the layer gradient at their cell
centers, including the unused final buffer planes. A separate test checks
interface placement and interpolation with deliberately invalid padding.

The independent check identified and corrected GraphSplit's initial use of a
6371 km sphere for NLL SIMPLE. NonLinLoc's `geo.h` uses 6371.0087714 km. Its
SIMPLE header does not encode that radius, so older or customized versions need
separate verification.

The check also identified the distinction between NLL velocity cell centers and
TIME nodes. GraphSplit now handles the half-cell offset and unused outer planes
explicitly. See NonLinLoc's `VelModToGrid3d` in `src/Vel2Grid1.c` and the staggered
grid description in `src/Time_3d_NLL_multiSource.c`.
